essence: Deluded people persist in worldly activity driven by the cycle of birth and death.
People do not take up the dharma of Kula that frees from the bondage of existence.
Deluded humans affectionately beg the Lady of Kula without true understanding.
People pursue teachings that keep them bound by the results of action.
People neglect Kula-dharma despite its capacity to grant enjoyment and liberation.
